name: CIPHER
description: CIPHER (Calibrated Introspection via Partially Hidden Environment Rules) is a procedurally generated benchmark for evaluating metacognitive awareness and contingency planning in large language models. Each instance is a synthetic causal world governed by explicit rules, a subset of which is withheld from the model. Models are scored on four dimensions: objective plan quality, Brier-calibrated self-knowledge, attention to hidden-rule importance, and executive robustness.
citeAs: CIPHER: A Benchmark for Metacognitive Awareness and Contingency Planning in LLMs. NeurIPS 2026 Datasets and Benchmarks Track (under review).
rai:dataCollection: All instances are procedurally generated using a seeded random process. No human-generated text, web scrapes, or real-world data were used. Invented vocabulary (entity names, property words, causal language) is generated fresh per instance from abstract mathematical rules to prevent memorization from training data.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating metacognitive awareness and contingency planning capabilities of large language models. Intended for use as a benchmark to measure whether models can recognize the limits of their knowledge and form robust plans under uncertainty.
rai:dataBiases: The benchmark reflects the design choices of its authors regarding what constitutes metacognitive reasoning. The synthetic world model (Z_7 arithmetic, specific trigger/effect families) may not cover all real-world uncertainty structures. Difficulty is controlled by number of hidden rules, entities, and horizon length, which may not capture all axes of task complexity.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The dataset contains no personal, sensitive, or identifying information. All content is synthetically generated.
rai:dataLimitations: CIPHER operates in a synthetic text-only environment. Results may not generalize to real-world planning tasks with continuous state spaces, partial observability from perception, or multi-agent dynamics. The benchmark evaluates a specific operationalization of metacognition and should not be treated as a comprehensive measure of general epistemic awareness.
rai:annotationsPerItem: Ground-truth labels are programmatically derived from the generative process (oracle beam search, rule visibility flags, Brier calibration targets). No human annotation was performed.

distribution.name: instances.jsonl
distribution.description: 1000 benchmark instances in JSON Lines format. Each line is one self-contained instance.

field.name: seed
field.description: Random seed used to generate this instance.

field.name: difficulty
field.description: Difficulty stratum: easy, medium, or hard.

field.name: prompt
field.description: Natural-language prompt shown to the model. Contains visible rules, initial state, and task description. Hidden rules are fully absent.

field.name: hidden
field.description: Ground-truth data not shown to the model: full rule set, oracle scores, metacognitive labels, and scoring metadata.
